arc_summary: I'm creating a joyful childhood memory montage that starts with explosive energy and maintains high vitality throughout. The edit builds through playful interactions and laughter peaks, culminating in a warm, wholesome moment that leaves viewers smiling nostalgically. Every cut syncs to the music's rhythm, creating a dynamic flow that feels like flipping through cherished memories.

cuts.purpose: Immediate energy burst - clapping and singing establishes joyful tone from first frame
Playful movement - boy pushing motorcycle with girl steering shows active childhood fun
Peak laughter - expressive joy from children creates infectious happiness
Energetic action - boys jumping on trampoline with one falling adds playful chaos
Chaotic movement - visible laughter from children in indoor play scene
Fast rotation - joyful expressions during peak spinning activity
Physical interaction - peak laughter between hugging children shows connection
Athletic movement - boy's handstand and flip at music's energy peak
Expressive shouting - child's arm movements match musical intensity
Group tickling - peak laughter during physical play at loudest musical moment
Celebration bow - children receiving applause transitions to warm resolution
Wholesome lift - child being lifted with joyful interaction creates nostalgic warmth
Final smile - closer shot with text overlay 'Oh, to be this young again' lingers warmly
